"""Actual owner package builds with broken host remote-builder list disabled."""
import json, subprocess, time
from pathlib import Path
ROOT = Path(__file__).resolve().parent
results=[]
for owner, package in [('cairn','cairn'), ('valence','valence')]:
    cmd=['nix','build','--builders','','--max-jobs','2','--no-link','--print-out-paths',f'path:/home/brittonr/git/OnixResearch/{owner}#{package}']
    start=time.time()
    with (ROOT/f'{owner}-local-build.stdout').open('xb') as out, (ROOT/f'{owner}-local-build.stderr').open('xb') as err:
        result=subprocess.run(cmd,stdout=out,stderr=err)
    results.append({'owner':owner,'command':cmd,'exit':result.returncode,'started_unix':start,'finished_unix':time.time()})
    (ROOT/'local-build-results.json').write_text(json.dumps(results,indent=2)+'\n')
raise SystemExit(0 if all(row['exit']==0 for row in results) else 1)

#!/usr/bin/env python3
"""Actual owner-supported Valence Nix build; no dry-run and no approval claim."""
import json, subprocess, time
from pathlib import Path
ROOT = Path(__file__).resolve().parent
cmd = ['nix', 'build', '--no-link', '--print-out-paths', 'path:/home/brittonr/git/OnixResearch/valence#valence']
start = time.time()
with (ROOT / 'valence-build.stdout').open('xb') as out, (ROOT / 'valence-build.stderr').open('xb') as err:
    result = subprocess.run(cmd, stdout=out, stderr=err)
(ROOT / 'valence-build-result.json').write_text(json.dumps({'command': cmd, 'exit': result.returncode, 'started_unix': start, 'finished_unix': time.time()}, indent=2) + '\n')
raise SystemExit(result.returncode)

#!/usr/bin/env python3
"""TEST-ONLY current Cairn public CLI and independent Valence CLI compatibility.
Only published fixture seeds are used. No reviewed-source or reviewer authority.
"""
import copy
import json
from pathlib import Path
import subprocess
import sys
import time

RUN = Path(__file__).resolve().parent
INPUT = RUN / 'TEST-ONLY-NOT-REAL-REVIEW'
INPUT.mkdir(mode=0o700, exist_ok=False)
OUT = RUN / 'receipts'
OUT.mkdir(mode=0o700, exist_ok=False)
CAIRN, VALENCE = sys.argv[1:3]
OPENSSL = '/nix/store/gvglnxscmvx4mh9my0cy0xgi0l1z6l9s-openssl-3.5.9-bin/bin/openssl'
FIXTURE = Path('/home/brittonr/scratch/cairn-source-review/fixtures/source-review/TEST-ONLY-keys')
records = []

def digest(data):
    return subprocess.check_output(['b3sum', '--no-names'], input=data).decode().strip()

def save(name, value):
    path = INPUT / name
    path.write_text(json.dumps(value, indent=2) + '\n')
    return path

def capture(label, command, expected=0):
    command = [str(arg) for arg in command]
    start = time.time()
    with (RUN / (label + '.stdout')).open('xb') as out, (RUN / (label + '.stderr')).open('xb') as err:
        result = subprocess.run(command, stdout=out, stderr=err, timeout=90)
    records.append({'label': label, 'command': command, 'exit': result.returncode, 'expected_exit': expected, 'started_unix': start, 'finished_unix': time.time(), 'stdout': label+'.stdout', 'stderr': label+'.stderr'})
    (RUN / 'commands.json').write_text(json.dumps(records, indent=2)+'\n')
    if result.returncode != expected:
        raise RuntimeError('unexpected exit for '+label)
    return (RUN / (label + '.stdout')).read_bytes()

capture('signer-version', [OPENSSL, 'version'])
keys=[]
for who in ['reviewer-a', 'reviewer-b']:
    seed_file=FIXTURE/(who+'.seed.hex')
    seed=bytes.fromhex(seed_file.read_text().strip())
    key=INPUT/(who+'.PUBLIC-TEST-ONLY.der')
    key.write_bytes(bytes.fromhex('302e020100300506032b657004220420')+seed)
    key.chmod(0o600)
    public_der=capture(who+'-derive-public', [OPENSSL, 'pkey', '-inform', 'DER', '-in', key, '-pubout', '-outform', 'DER'])
    assert len(public_der)==44 and public_der[:12].hex()=='302a300506032b6570032100'
    public=public_der[12:]
    assert public.hex()==(FIXTURE/(who+'.public.hex')).read_text().strip()
    keys.append({'who':who, 'key':key, 'public':public, 'identity':digest(public), 'seed_source':str(seed_file), 'seed_source_blake3':digest(seed_file.read_bytes())})

non_claims=sorted('source-review-does-not-prove-'+s for s in ['source-correctness','review-quality','build-correctness','reproducibility','witness-independence','deployment-safety','release-eligibility'])
archive=b'PUBLIC TEST ONLY synthetic source archive bytes; not Mantle release source.\n'
(INPUT/'SYNTHETIC-source-archive.bin').write_bytes(archive)
label_hash=lambda text:digest(('PUBLIC TEST ONLY '+text).encode())
subject={'schema':'cairn.source-review-subject.v1', 'source_archive_blake3':digest(archive), 'source_revision':'TEST-ONLY-NOT-A-REAL-REVISION', 'source_tree_blake3':None, 'snapshot_profile':'mantle-release-source', 'snapshot_profile_version':1, 'projection':'source'}
root={'claim_identity':label_hash('synthetic claim identity'), 'subject_root':label_hash('synthetic existing claim-DAG root'), 'revision':1}
context={'profile':'test-only-currentness.v1', 'algorithm':'blake3', 'digest_hex':label_hash('synthetic currentness')}
review_policy=label_hash('synthetic reviewed policy')
policy={'schema':'cairn.source-review-verification-policy.v1', 'subject':subject, 'claim_root':root, 'review_policy_blake3':review_policy, 'authentication_policy':{'schema':'artifact-auth.policy.v1','profile_id':'cairn.source-review.v1','threshold':2,'trusted_keys':[{'producer_id':key['who']+'-TEST-ONLY','key_id':'same-PUBLIC-TEST-ONLY-label','key_identity':{'profile':'ed25519-public-key.v1','algorithm':'blake3','digest_hex':key['identity']}, 'allowed_purposes':['source-review-approval'], 'generation':1,'currentness':'current','currentness_ref':context} for key in keys]}, 'verifier_context':context,'author_key_blake3':[],'exclude_authors':True,'required_approvals':2,'non_claims':non_claims}
save('policy-two.json',policy)
one_policy=copy.deepcopy(policy)
one_policy['authentication_policy']['threshold']=1
one_policy['required_approvals']=1
save('policy-one.json',one_policy)
claim={'schema':'cairn.source-review-claim.v1','subject':subject,'claim_root':root,'review_policy_blake3':review_policy,'disposition':'approved','non_claims':non_claims}
save('claim.json',claim)
raw_proof=[]
for key in keys:
    who=key['who']
    args=[CAIRN,'source-review','signing-request','--root',INPUT,'--claim','claim.json','--policy','policy-two.json','--producer',who+'-TEST-ONLY','--key-id','same-PUBLIC-TEST-ONLY-label','--generation','1','--public-key-hex',key['public'].hex()]
    request_bytes=capture(who+'-signing-request',args)
    (INPUT/(who+'-request.json')).write_bytes(request_bytes)
    request=json.loads(request_bytes)
    raw=capture(who+'-raw',args+['--raw'])
    raw_path=INPUT/(who+'-statement.bin')
    raw_path.write_bytes(raw)
    assert raw==bytes.fromhex(request['canonical_statement_hex'])
    assert digest(raw)==request['statement_blake3']
    signature=INPUT/(who+'-signature.bin')
    capture(who+'-external-sign',[OPENSSL,'pkeyutl','-sign','-inkey',key['key'],'-keyform','DER','-rawin','-in',raw_path,'-out',signature])
    assert len(signature.read_bytes())==64
    raw_proof.append({'reviewer':who,'canonical_raw_matches_request':True,'raw_blake3':digest(raw),'signature_blake3':digest(signature.read_bytes())})

def assemble(who,label,includes=()):
    cmd=[CAIRN,'source-review','assemble','--root',INPUT,'--request',who+'-request.json','--policy','policy-two.json','--signature-hex',(INPUT/(who+'-signature.bin')).read_bytes().hex()]
    for row in includes: cmd+=['--include',row]
    attachment=capture(label,cmd)
    (INPUT/(label+'.json')).write_bytes(attachment)
    return json.loads(attachment)
one=assemble('reviewer-a','one-reviewer')
save('row-a.json',one['reviews'][0])
two=assemble('reviewer-b','two-reviewer',['row-a.json'])
tampered=copy.deepcopy(two)
sig=tampered['reviews'][0]['signature_hex']
tampered['reviews'][0]['signature_hex']=('0' if sig[0]!='0' else '1')+sig[1:]
save('tampered-signature.json',tampered)
wrong_role=copy.deepcopy(policy)
wrong_role['authentication_policy']['trusted_keys'][0]['allowed_purposes']=['build-witness']
save('wrong-role-policy.json',wrong_role)
cases=[('one-reviewer-positive','one-reviewer.json','policy-one.json',0,'accepted_manual_review',1),('two-reviewer-positive','two-reviewer.json','policy-two.json',0,'accepted_manual_review',2),('threshold-negative','one-reviewer.json','policy-two.json',1,'insufficient',1),('tampered-signature-negative','tampered-signature.json','policy-two.json',1,'invalid',0),('wrong-role-negative','two-reviewer.json','wrong-role-policy.json',1,'invalid',0)]
observed=[]
for label,attachment,selected,expected,outcome,count in cases:
    producer=capture('cairn-'+label,[CAIRN,'source-review','verify','--root',INPUT,'--attachment',attachment,'--policy',selected],expected)
    if outcome!='invalid':
        report=json.loads(producer)['report']
        assert report['outcome']==outcome and len(report['approved_key_blake3'])==count
(RUN/'producer-complete.json').write_text(json.dumps({'test_only':True,'producer_path':CAIRN,'producer_blake3':digest(Path(CAIRN).read_bytes()),'raw_statement_proof':raw_proof,'commands':records},indent=2)+'\n')
deadline=time.monotonic()+1800
while not Path(VALENCE).exists():
    if time.monotonic()>deadline:
        raise RuntimeError('Receiver build did not produce executable within bounded wait; producer evidence preserved')
    build_results=json.loads((RUN/'local-build-results.json').read_bytes())
    if any(row['owner']=='valence' and row['exit']!=0 for row in build_results):
        raise RuntimeError('Actual owner Valence build failed; producer evidence preserved')
    time.sleep(2)
receiver_store=Path(VALENCE).parent.parent
capture('root-current-valence',['nix-store','--add-root',RUN/'valence-gcroot','--realise',receiver_store])
for label,attachment,selected,expected,outcome,count in cases:
    receipt_bytes=capture('valence-'+label,[VALENCE,'source-review','verify','--artifact-root',INPUT,'--attachment',attachment,'--policy',selected,'--output-root',OUT,'--receipt',label+'.json'],expected)
    receipt=json.loads(receipt_bytes)
    assert receipt['outcome']==outcome and len(receipt['approved_key_blake3'])==count
    assert receipt['verification_role']=='manual_review' and receipt['non_claims']==non_claims
    assert receipt['attachment_artifact_blake3']==digest((INPUT/attachment).read_bytes())
    assert receipt['policy_artifact_blake3']==digest((INPUT/selected).read_bytes())
    assert json.loads((OUT/(label+'.json')).read_bytes())==receipt
    observed.append({'case':label,'outcome':outcome,'approved_distinct_keys':count,'issues':receipt['issues'],'receipt_blake3':receipt['receipt_blake3'],'receipt_file_blake3':digest((OUT/(label+'.json')).read_bytes())})
summary={'schema':'mantle-source-review-public-cli-test-only-v1','test_only':True,'real_reviewer_approval':False,'producer':{'path':CAIRN,'blake3':digest(Path(CAIRN).read_bytes())},'independent_receiver':{'path':VALENCE,'blake3':digest(Path(VALENCE).read_bytes()),'boundary':'Current owner public Valence CLI; internally invokes independent valence_core::source_review::accept_source_review_bytes'},'external_signer':{'path':OPENSSL,'blake3':digest(Path(OPENSSL).read_bytes())},'public_test_keys':[{k:v for k,v in key.items() if k in ['who','identity','seed_source','seed_source_blake3']} for key in keys],'raw_statement_proof':raw_proof,'cases':observed,'commands':records,'non_claims':non_claims,'missing_real_authority':['Actual reviewed release-source cohort and genuine reviewer-authorized claims/signatures','Operator-selected genuine full-key/currentness/revocation policy for that release'],'v5_complete':False}
(RUN/'compatibility-report.json').write_text(json.dumps(summary,indent=2)+'\n')
print(json.dumps({'completed_cases':observed,'test_only':True},indent=2))
